Each tuple is associated with a confidence score derived from conformal prediction applied to source evidence. The Roster Truth Infrastructure extends this by treating each roster fact as a random variable with a posterior distribution over valid assignments, enabling Bayesian updating as new evidence arrives. Source Evidence Snapshots provide i.i.d. samples from this distribution, while the Reconciliation Plan acts as a maximum likelihood estimator under a hierarchy of source credibility. Together, these primitives create a robust, mathematically grounded framework for managing high-stakes, low-frequency errors in sports data.
